The "12 inch" measurement refers to the diameter of the sphere itself (the ball part), not the full height of the globe with its base and stand. I don't have the exact overall height (including the stand/meridian) for the Lenox listed in what I have on hand, so I'd rather not guess at that number.

For the exact overall height, the product page itself or our team at (email hidden) can confirm it precisely. That said, I should mention the Lenox 12" Antique Ocean Desk Globe - French Edition is currently sold out — if you'd like something in the same style and size that's in stock, the Quincy 9-inch Antique Ocean Desk Globe (French Edition) is available, though that's a smaller 9" sphere. Would a desk globe around that size work for your space, or are you open to something larger?
